body.name: Rational interval branch-and-bound certificate
body.construction: A certificate \(\mathsf{cert}\) is a finite rational partition tree for the explicitly encoded set \(\{(p,s):p\in C_n,\ s\in S_h^{\mathrm{cert}}(p)\}\). Every leaf records one finite-disjunct branch of \(C_n\), the simplex constraints, every coded-law equality or its two directed certified enclosure inequalities, and every required coding-cell and query-integral enclosure. The checker uses exact rational interval extensions for polynomial, \(\min\), \(\max\), and ReLU atoms, verifies the integral-enclosure records, checks rational Farkas deductions and exact semialgebraic infeasibility witnesses, and confirms the total endpoint enclosures \(L_{\mathrm{cert}}\le\inf Q_h^{\mathrm{cert}}\le L_{\mathrm{cert}}+\epsilon_{\mathrm{opt}}\) and \(U_{\mathrm{cert}}-\epsilon_{\mathrm{opt}}\le\sup Q_h^{\mathrm{cert}}\le U_{\mathrm{cert}}\), with integral-enclosure error included in \(\epsilon_{\mathrm{opt}}\).
